narrative: Today's top stories highlight advancements in AI memory systems and coding agents, alongside intriguing developments in autonomous vehicle battery repurposing and contactless payment technology. Space exploration also features prominently with new insights into Jupiter and Earth's early elements.

highlights.title: A burglar used a Waymo to steal yoga clothes in San Francisco — and got away with it
highlights.whyItMatters: The incident sheds new light on Waymo's handling of robotaxi footage and storage.

highlights.title: GitHub Universe is back: All together now, in the agentic era
highlights.whyItMatters: GitHub Universe returns to focus on the agentic era, emphasizing new tools and updates for developers.

highlights.title: Cash App made a magic wand for contactless payments
highlights.whyItMatters: Cash App introduces an NFC-enabled wand for magical, on-the-go contactless payments.

highlights.title: Colorful, Chaotic Jupiter
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA's Juno spacecraft captured a color-enhanced view of Jupiter's northern hemisphere, revealing detailed chaotic clouds.

highlights.title: Dreaming: Better memory for a more helpful ChatGPT
highlights.whyItMatters: ChatGPT introduces a new memory system to better remember preferences, enhancing conversational context and relevance.

highlights.title: Elixir v1.20: Now a gradually typed language
highlights.whyItMatters: Elixir's new version 1.20 introduces gradual typing, enhancing developer experience and code robustness.

highlights.title: Used Waymo robotaxi batteries become backup storage for power grids
highlights.whyItMatters: Waymo's spent robotaxi batteries are being repurposed for grid storage, contributing to sustainable energy solutions.

highlights.title: OpenAI named a Leader in enterprise coding agents by Gartner
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI's Codex is recognized for innovation and enterprise-scale deployment in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents.
